aggregator.explanation: Lesson 2 is the clear overall winner: five of the six dimension agents preferred it, with very high confidence in interactivity, narration quality, synchronization, and concept accuracy, plus a moderate visual-accuracy advantage. These dimensions indicate Lesson 2 is mathematically coherent, narrated, timed, interactive, and more relevant visually. Lesson 1 only wins polish, with high confidence, due to better legibility and composition, but that single strength is outweighed by Lesson 2’s broad advantages across core instructional dimensions.
